'''Ku-ki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the fourteenth [[keeper of memories]] of the [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] following the death of [[Rukil]], and the tribe's Promised One. She recorded at least one [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] about the fate of the Outcasts following their exodus to the [[Promised Land]], which was discovered by a Republic-allied individual on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. She was eventually succeeded by [[Lurr (individual)|Lurr]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ku-ki was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
